title: mutation-invariance.config.json
description: The merge protocol's mutation-invariant path allowlist, described in CLAUDE.md's merge-protocol step 5. `allow[]` names a path argued not to move `npm run test:mutation`'s score, with `securedBy` naming what that argument rests on -- two of the three tiers are machine-checked and `written-argument` is not, so validation passing is not a proof for a `written-argument` entry. `absent[]` records a path that was considered and ruled out, each with a `reason`.

scope.description: Which mutation run this predicate is argued for. The allowlist is sound for `npm run test:mutation` (stryker.config.json's src/-scoped run) only -- see CLAUDE.md's merge-protocol step 5 for why that scope is load-bearing.

path.description: A bare tracked-file path, or a directory in the `dir/**` form. No other glob syntax is accepted -- no glob engine appears anywhere in this program.
